'''Gor Jolda''' was a [[Nikto/Legends|Nikto]] who was a low-level member of a [[Unidentified gang (Gor Jolda)|gang]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].<ref name="Mission" /> Around [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="Date">Per the reasoning [[Template:TOR_dates|here]], Act I of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' takes place around [[3643 BBY]]. Since players of ''The Old Republic'' can assign their companions on the mission "Mysterious Offer" independently of the main class storyline at any point during the [[Star Wars video games|game]], the mission must take place at some point around 3643 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]].</ref> Jolda sought to recruit someone outside of his gang to make a delivery.<ref name="Mission" />

{{GameMechanics|legends=1|Star Wars: The Old Republic}}
By that [[Standard year/Legends|year]],<ref name="Date" /> an individual associated with one of the two major powers in the Cold War sent a companion to learn the details of Jolda's delivery job. The companion helped Jolda arm his followers, allowing them to depose a [[Unidentified crime lord (Gor Jolda)|local crime lord]]. The individual's companion was rewarded greatly for assisting with Jolda's successful power play.<ref name="Mission" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
Gor Jolda was mentioned in the Crew Skill mission "Mysterious Offer" in the [[2011]] [[BioWare]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]], ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''. The information regarding the mission's outcome was later removed.<ref name="Mission" />
